title: The Catch — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning Pete fishing
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The catch is the moment everything the morning said was true
The line goes tight and something from the deep is coming through
The rod bends to the water and the reel begins to sing
The catch is every reason why the charter boats take wing

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La captura es el momento cuando todo lo que la mañana prometió
[The catch is the moment when everything the morning promised]
Se hace realidad — el hilo se tensa y el pez llegó
[Comes true — the line goes tight and the fish arrived]
La caña se dobla hacia el agua y el carrete comienza a cantar
[The rod bends to the water and the reel begins to sing]
La captura es la razón por la que las lanchas van al mar
[The catch is the reason the charter boats go to sea]

[Chorus — English]
The catch, the catch
Forty metres down and now it's coming up to match
Every story on the deck starts with this
The line went tight and something sent its wish
And Pete had put the boat exactly where the fish were right
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La prise est le moment où tout ce que le matin avait dit est vrai
[The catch is the moment when everything the morning said is true]
La ligne se tend et quelque chose des profondeurs arrive
[The line goes tight and something from the depths arrives]
La canne se courbe vers l'eau et le moulinet commence à chanter
[The rod bends toward the water and the reel begins to sing]
La prise est la raison pour laquelle les bateaux charter vont naviguer
[The catch is the reason why the charter boats go sailing]

[Outro — All three languages]
The catch knows Pete was waiting… La captura sabe que Pete esperaba… La prise sait que Pete attendait
Line went tight — El hilo se tensó — La ligne s'est tendue
That's my boy
